summary: A Quote subscription: a full quote packet, then a partial one whose missing and zero fields keep their last values.

notes: Frames follow the INDstocks price socket's documented shape (indmoney_adapter.py:575-583: mode, instrument, timestamp in ms, data) with fractional prices so a price's JSON type is not what differs.

deviations.reason: Follows the broker's web adapter; set in the per-broker dialect entry (lane wire) in Phase B. The desktop sends the label (ltp, quote); INDmoney's web adapter sends the subscription's mode number (indmoney_adapter.py:611).

The web sends the packet's own millisecond timestamp as timestamp, the same value it sends as ltt (indmoney_adapter.py:610-614); the desktop sends that value as ltt and its receipt time as timestamp. Which time a frame's timestamp carries when the broker stamps its packets is a desktop-wide wire question (HDFC Sky has the same): lead decision.
INDmoney's quote stream carries no last traded quantity; the web leaves it out, the desktop sends 0 because the adapter marks nothing absent (desktop defect).

The desktop sends the best bid's quantity as the total buy quantity; the stream carries no book totals and the web sends none. One level's quantity is not the exchange's total (invented data, desktop defect).

The desktop sends the best ask's quantity as the total sell quantity; the stream carries no book totals and the web sends none. One level's quantity is not the exchange's total (invented data, desktop defect).

The web's Quote frame carries the quote's best bid and ask, price and quantity (indmoney_adapter.py:681-684); the desktop's frame has no Quote bid/ask fields to carry them (carrier gap for lane wire, then the adapter fills them).

The web's Quote frame carries OI as the stream sends it (indmoney_adapter.py:686); the desktop's Quote frame carries OI only for a Depth subscription (feed::bridge::quote_fields), so a Quote holder of a future loses its open interest (carrier gap).
The web's Quote frame carries the stream's OI change (indmoney_adapter.py:687); the desktop's carrier has no OI-change field (carrier gap for lane wire, then the adapter fills it).
